title: JSON-RPC 2.0 Wire Format Specification
description: The codec module implements newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 transport.
body: Wire format: JSON-RPC 2.0, one object per line, newline-delimited. Everything here is transport-agnostic -- it knows how to turn a line of text into a typed message and back, and nothing about processes, pipes, or pending calls. `host.rs` and `tool.rs` own those. See `docs/tool-protocol.md` section 2 for the prose spec this mirrors.
